widgets.title: New pod restarts with reason
nrql: FROM K8sContainerSample SELECT sum(restartCountDelta) AS 'new_restarts' WHERE clusterName = concat('acme-cluster-', {{env}}) AND namespaceName = 'acme-backend' FACET deploymentName, lastTerminatedExitReason TIMESERIES AUTO since 1 weeks ago

notes: no metric mapping for FROM K8sContainerSample

widgets.title: Public Deployment - Pods Allocation
nrql: SELECT max(k8s.deployment.podsAvailable) as 'Available', max(k8s.deployment.podsDesired) as 'Desired', max(k8s.deployment.podsMissing) as 'Missing' from Metric where k8s.namespaceName = 'acme-backend' WHERE `k8s.clusterName` = concat('acme-cluster-', {{env}}) and k8s.deploymentName LIKE 'acme-backend-public' TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 2 hours ago

notes: attribute 'k8s.clusterName' not in label_map; used 'k8s_clusterName' — verify the label exists in your stack
attribute 'k8s.deploymentName' not in label_map; used 'k8s_deploymentName' — verify the label exists in your stack
assumed gauge 'k8s_deployment_podsAvailable'; verify metric name/type in Mimir and add to metric_map if wrong
assumed gauge 'k8s_deployment_podsDesired'; verify metric name/type in Mimir and add to metric_map if wrong
assumed gauge 'k8s_deployment_podsMissing'; verify metric name/type in Mimir and add to metric_map if wrong
